_note: The landlord's particulars an employee gives the employer to have HRA counted at source (D-167; rulebook R9 SAL-HRA-006). A notice, never a figure: ExemptionNode annotates the first HRA line where HRA applies in the regime and the aggregate rent paid for the year's tenancies exceeds the threshold — exactly the threshold does not. TY 2026-27: Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.205(2) Table Sl. 1 (p.1687): "House rent allowance. — Name, address and Permanent Account Number of the landlord or landlords, where the aggregate rent paid during the tax year exceeds ₹ 100000 and relationship with the landlord, if any.", furnished in Form No. 124 to the person paying under s.392(1) (r.205(1)). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.26C(2) Table Sl. 1, inserted by S.O. 1587(E) from 1-6-2016 (egazette 2016/169418, p.6): "Name, address and permanent account number of the landlord/landlords where the aggregate rent paid during the previous year exceeds rupees one lakh", in Form No. 12BB — no relationship limb; r.26C unamended to 31-3-2026 (the Department's consolidated rule, 13-12-2025); Form No. 12BB takes the PAN or Aadhaar number from 1-9-2019 (Income-tax (Twelfth Amendment) Rules, 2019, per the Department's form).
